TYPE: document
SUBJECT: A scanned 1952 typewritten letter on letterhead from Tekakwitha Indian Mission Inc., Sisseton, South Dakota, addressed to Mr. and Mrs. Seely. It thanks them for a donation of 10.00 for my little Indians, describes the invitation as the first ever extended to one of the mission's papooses to spend a vacation, and offers to send a little boy of six years or older or a little girl, closing with a handwritten signature.
TEXT: TEKAKWITHA INDIAN MISSION INC.
Sisseton, South Dakota
April 5th, 1952
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Seely:
Thank you very kindly for your donation of 10.00 for my little Indians.
You'rs is the first invitation that was ever extended to one of our papooses to come and spend the vacation some where. We have a few little boys and girls who have no one at all interested, wuther they live or die or come and go.
I would send a little boy of six years or older or a little girl what ever you prefer. These Indian children are very little trouble, especially the one I have in mind.
If you really mean it, I will see that we get him ready; you may have him any time you desire. I am not making any inquiries about you, because it takes a good person to make an offer as you did!
Please, let me know.
With kindest regards
[signature]
SYMBOLS: numbers
